description: Found by live verification of #3952 and split out of influxdb-load-ignores-compressed-tsbs-files-20261106. benchbox/platforms/influxdb/metadata.py, setup.py and the platform option spec default to 8086 (InfluxDB 2's port) while docker/influxdb/docker-compose.yml and the adapter's default_service_port use 8181 (InfluxDB 3), so `--platform-option port=8181` is needed against the repo's stack. Changing the default affects InfluxDB 2 users and needs an owner decision on whether the core/cloud modes should default differently (for example 8181 for core, 443 for cloud) before any edit.
